name: The Deathstalkers
summary: In the Undercity, the Deathstalkers turn Andron Gant's trust against him. Believing you are the courier he expected, Gant gives you a ledger for his secret contacts. You take it to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter, opening the way to deeper covert work for the Forsaken state.

sections.title: A Courier in the Shadows
sections.body: Andron Gant keeps names and information in a personal ledger in the Undercity. Believing you are the courier he expected, he gives you the ledger to deliver to his secret contacts. Gant asks for the same courier to carry future messages. He does not know the ledger is bound for the Deathstalkers.

sections.title: Intelligence in the Rogues' Quarter
sections.body: Mennet Carkad receives Gant's ledger in the Rogues' Quarter and finds more useful intelligence than he expected. Its details give Carkad leads to widen the Deathstalkers' investigations. The Forsaken realm is wary, and these records may help uncover subversion within its borders and threats beyond them before they reach the capital.

faq.answer: Andron Gant's ledger holds sensitive information and records he gathered. Mennet Carkad finds more detail and valuable intelligence in it than the Deathstalkers expected.

The Deathstalkers are the Forsaken's covert organization and assassin guild. Based in the Undercity's Rogues' Quarter, they serve Lady Sylvanas Windrunner as eyes, ears, and hidden daggers. They handle espionage, intelligence, and targeted assassinations across Lordaeron.

faq.q: Why does Gant want the same courier used in the future?
faq.answer: Gant wants future sensitive documents carried by a runner he trusts. Using the same courier preserves their working arrangement and lowers the risk of theft or tampering.

Mennet Carkad is a Deathstalkers operative in the Rogues' Quarter. He coordinates local agents, gathers field intelligence from informants such as Andron Gant, and directs covert assignments throughout the capital and surrounding territories.

faq.q: Where is the Rogues' Quarter located?
faq.answer: The Rogues' Quarter lies in the southern district of the Undercity. It is the main base for Forsaken stealth operatives, thieves, and assassins, with training grounds and dark alcoves away from the public plazas of the upper ruins.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken need an internal intelligence agency?
faq.answer: The Forsaken need internal intelligence to uncover subversion within Lordaeron's borders. The Deathstalkers work to help the young nation survive threats from the Scourge, the Scarlet Crusade, wary Alliance remnants, infiltration, and rebellion.

angles.text: As a rogue in the Undercity, you can show your discretion by carrying sensitive messages for Mennet Carkad without drawing unwanted attention.
As an undead, you know the Undercity's security is a matter of survival. Helping the Deathstalkers strengthens the Dark Lady's hold over the capital against living infiltrators and rival undead.
